subject: Overall ability estimation/score for multidimensional IRT

messages.author: 3fd30254cc2deeb1
messages.subject: Overall ability estimation/score for multidimensional IRT
parts:
Dear Phil, is it possible to obtain an overall ability score for the multidimensional graded response model? 
I try to get ability estimates for the data obtained from the psychological scale with 5 subdimensions, and I need an uniqe score to represent each person besides the estimates of subdimensions. 
I am looking forward ro hear your answer about the estimation of overall scores.

Thanks in advance

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Overall ability estimation/score for multidimensional IRT
parts:
The only way to accomplish this realistically in mirt is to have fit something like a bifactor model to start with, that way the general ability would represent the overall composite score across the test after conditioning on the local item dependencies between the specific factors. 

Phil
